source.conversion: Computed: each player's value is a weighted sum of standardised signals of his position (their share of their school's passes, carries and catches, their yards, the tackles, sacks and passes defended their plays name, their interceptions and field goals, his 247Sports recruiting grade and his years in college), pooled over 2020 and the two seasons before it 3:2:1; the weights were fitted to College Football 27's launch ratings of the players of 2025 who returned in 2026 and frozen. Each school's best at each position (College Football 27's depth) are ranked across the season's FBS schools and read off College Football 27's ratings at that position (Week 10 Ratings). Each school then moves toward its results: its Simple Rating System over the season's games between FBS schools (reliability 0.856), in which a conference whose schools met other conferences fewer times than it has schools (the Big Ten 5 times, the MAC 2, the Mountain West 8, the Pac-12 3 and the SEC 9) has its level held toward the mean of its levels in 2019 and 2021, counted as one more observation of it, as precise as that mean's own error and the 2.5 points² a conference's level strays from the seasons either side allow, times √reliability ÷ 4.521 points a game per point of played strength, about the schools' mean 80.11; every player of the school by a whole number and its best few one more, never reordered.
